named_instruments_referenced: Political Declaration on Responsible Military Use of AI and Autonomy
annotation.summary_en: U.S. State Department web page describing the Political Declaration on Responsible Military Use of AI and Autonomy, launched in February 2023 at REAIM in The Hague. It notes the March 2024 inaugural plenary of endorsing states and US plans for regular dialogue, and links to the declaration text in several languages.
key_provisions_or_claims: Declaration is a non-binding normative framework for military AI and autonomy
Launched February 2023 at REAIM in The Hague
Inaugural plenary of endorsing states held March 19-20, 2024
US will convene regular dialogue among endorsing states
All states are encouraged to endorse the Declaration
